context: 14 Oct held early, then ended in a rejection in all three indices; the rejection was not big, so sellers did not get activated.
plan: FLAT TO GAP DOWN -> SELL: the late rejection did not activate sellers -- identify selling-side setups.
GAP UP -> BUY, WITH THE MARKET: if the rejection was only a trap for buyers and the open is a good one, go with the market -- identify buying-side setups.
SMALL GAP UP: the same buy plan if price crosses its higher point.
